title: Async image loader with dedup and cancellation
summary: Load images for a scrolling list: memory cache, deduplicate concurrent requests for the same URL, and cancel when a cell is reused.
approach: Actor holding a cache and in-flight tasks keyed by URL (see actor reentrancy). Per-cell, keep the `Task` handle and cancel it in `prepareForReuse`/`onDisappear`.
body: Follow-ups: cancelling the shared download only when no caller still wants it (reference count waiters); disk cache; prefetching; downsampling to the cell size to bound memory.
